sources.short_quote: registered custom properties substitute as their computed value, rather than the original token sequence used to produce that value.
Properties that affect the font size or font metrics of an element are font-affecting properties.
Determining the computed value for the custom property implies that property replacement takes place, which may cause a cycle.
